summary: P0-3 Blindness/Staleness Detection + Linux Sensor Recovery review. Backend: 10/11 pytest tests pass. Frontend: all acceptance criteria pass — freshness banner, endpoint chip with data-delivery-state/basis, statement, endpoint statement, thresholds line with literal derivation formula, window control with 1/24/72/168/720h buttons, counts change on widening (89→551 in-window on live device), EVIDENCE_OUTSIDE_WINDOW renders with heading + most-recent timestamp + real out-of-window counts (3 procs / 40 obs), overview banner present, and ENDPOINT_NOT_RESOLVED banner renders on process-tree, response and detections for forged identifier. Regression pages load unaffected. One backend gap: for the never-delivered endpoint (BLIND_NO_DELIVERY), the returned row does not include an addressed_by.resolved_via == ENROLMENT_REGISTRY_DIRECT field required by the acceptance criteria — the row has no addressed_by key at all. State and basis are correct; only the addressing provenance is missing.

minor.issue: BLIND_NO_DELIVERY row is missing the addressed_by field entirely. Acceptance requires addressed_by.resolved_via == 'ENROLMENT_REGISTRY_DIRECT' to prove the enrolment-registry fallback path. State=BLIND_NO_DELIVERY and basis=NEVER_DELIVERED are correct. Fix in backend/services/edr/telemetry_freshness.py::_rows() — the enrolment-registry fallback branch must attach an addressed_by object like it does for the live-endpoint branch.

action_items: In backend/services/edr/telemetry_freshness.py::_rows(), when the endpoint is resolved via the enrolment-registry-direct fallback (never-delivered rows), populate row['addressed_by'] = {'resolved_via': 'ENROLMENT_REGISTRY_DIRECT', ...} so the ep_a01197382b9aeb861045 acceptance case passes.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend correctly enforces heartbeat authentication (POST /api/edr/agent/heartbeat returns 401/403 unauthenticated).
Tenant isolation for analyst@nivx-live is honest: no leakage of ep_2d57cbe6f80152062109 or the agent-env hostname in the response body when analyst queries dev_42e8c6dc74b9.
Forged identifier response is well formed: state=ENDPOINT_NOT_RESOLVED, endpoints=[], and the fleet-block scope discriminator is FLEET_WIDE_NOT_THE_SUPPLIED_IDENTIFIER as required.
Thresholds formula is rendered verbatim by the UI ('stale_after_s = max(report_interval_s × 3, 60) · blind_after_s = max(report_interval_s × 20, 900)') — no browser-side computation observed.
cadence_basis=DECLARED_BY_SENSOR + report_interval_s=15 verified for the live Linux sensor.
Only gap is the missing addressed_by object on enrolment-registry-direct rows (see minor issue).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The single outstanding gap is addressed_by.resolved_via on the never-delivered endpoint row. Everything else in the P0-3 acceptance list passes. Live Linux sensor is delivering under supervisor; counts on dev_42e8c6dc74b9 grow between calls — do not assert on exact counts. Frontend test-ids used: edr-freshness-banner, edr-freshness-endpoint-chip, edr-freshness-statement, edr-freshness-endpoint-statement, edr-freshness-thresholds, edr-processtree-window-control, edr-processtree-window-{1,24,72,168,720}, edr-processtree-window-counts, edr-processtree-outside-window, edr-{processtree,response,endpoint-detections}-not-resolved.
rca of the issue: The enrolment-registry fallback branch in telemetry_freshness._rows() constructs a synthetic row for endpoints that have enrolled but never delivered. That branch does not currently attach an 'addressed_by' object to the row, whereas the live-endpoint branch does. Because the query for a never-delivered endpoint goes exclusively through the fallback branch, the response omits addressed_by entirely — even though the underlying resolution truly is ENROLMENT_REGISTRY_DIRECT. Mitigation: mirror the addressed_by dict construction from the live branch in the fallback branch, using resolved_via='ENROLMENT_REGISTRY_DIRECT' and echoing the supplied identifier.
